subject: FinEdge follow-up: redlines submitted — checking timing & next steps
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Emily Choi <emily.choi@finedge.io>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@finedge.io>
Cc: procurement@finedge.io
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 15:12:00 -0000
Subject: Discovery recap + next steps (FinEdge pilot)

Hi Emily / Liam —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Goal: 8-week pilot for search + summarization on customer support tickets (targeting 20k monthly queries).
- Success metrics: 30% reduction in mean time to resolution, <=300ms 95th percentile latency for query path.
- Next: legal & procurement review of standard MSA + SOW, then pilot onboarding (kickoff call, test data ingestion).

I expect legal redlines will be the longest pole — if it helps, we can accept a limited-data clause and a one-quarter data retention window while counsel finishes the full agreement review.

Attached: draft SOW and example runbook we discussed (see Drive link in thread metadata).

Can you confirm who on your side will lead procurement review and an ETA for counsel feedback? I’ll loop in our Legal lead for anything that needs negotiation.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0183

From: Emily Choi <emily.choi@finedge.io>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@finedge.io>, procurement@finedge.io
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 10:05:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + next steps (FinEdge pilot)

Thanks Jordan —

Counsel reviewed the MSA and SOW and submitted redlines. Attaching the PDF with comments (FinEdge_Redlines_20270512.pdf). High level: a) data residency & access logging, b) indemnity carveouts around third-party data, c) SLAs targeted but want a calendar-based uptime rather than token-based credits.

Procurement (cc'd) will need pricing confirmation once legal signals we're good on terms. I can shadow counsel and push for a decision this week, but no firm ETA until I hear back from the GC.

—Emily
Emily Choi
Legal Counsel, FinEdge Analytics
emily.choi@finedge.io

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Emily Choi <emily.choi@finedge.io>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@finedge.io>, procurement@finedge.io
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 09:30:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + next steps (FinEdge pilot)

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the redlines, Emily — I reviewed the PDF you sent on Wed.

Quick thoughts from our side (high level):
- Data residency & logging: we can offer a VPC/private deployment option for the pilot (limited extra setup time).
- Indemnity: can we propose a capped carveout and a mutual indemnity clause to address third-party data exposures?
- SLA: we can translate the token-based guarantees into an uptime-backed credit structure; happy to share an example.

I've attached a draft response markup (Redwood_Response_Markup_20270515.pdf) with proposed positions for counsel to review. Can you confirm whether your GC prefers a single consolidated redline set or line-item responses?

If there's appetite, I can schedule a 20-minute call between our legal lead and your GC to resolve the few open points quickly — would Tuesday or Thursday next week work?

Thanks,
Jordan

Subject: FYI / counsel sync recommendation (FinEdge)

Lauren —

Looping you in on FinEdge (DEAL-2027-049). They returned redlines last week (attached) and requested clarity on indemnity and SLA form. I drafted a short response markup and flagged two concessions I think we can make to keep the pilot timeline intact:

1) Offer VPC deployment as a short-term mitigation for data residency questions (adds modest ops work).
2) Propose a mutual cap on indemnity tied to the pilot fee (limits exposure while offering reassurance).

I recommend a 20-minute alignment call between our legal lead and their GC — if you agree I can book directly.

Attachment: Redwood_Response_Markup_20270515.pdf

—Jordan

Hi Emily —

Following up on the redlines I reviewed earlier. Wanted to check whether counsel had time to review our response markup and whether procurement's timeline changed. We're holding the proposed pilot window (kickoff third week of June) but can accommodate a short delay if needed.

If it helps move things along, I'm happy to join a 15-minute call later this week to walk through the two narrow issues (indemnity cap + VPC deployment). Are you available Fri 2–3pm PT or Mon 9–10am PT?

Thanks — Jordan
